title.en: An Act Appropriating the Sum of Five Million Six Hundred Ninety-Four Thousand Eight Hundred Fifty-Four Pesos for the Implementation of Republic Act Numbered One Thousand Eight Hundred Thirty-One
title.orig: An Act Appropriating the Sum of Five Million Six Hundred Ninety-Four Thousand Eight Hundred Fifty-Four Pesos for the Implementation of Republic Act Numbered One Thousand Eight Hundred Thirty-One

text.en: The sum of five million six hundred ninety-four thousand eight hundred fifty-four pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to implement the provisions of Republic Act Numbered One thousand eight hundred thirty-one from the date of its effectivity.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 13, 1958.
